scope: Sequential exploratory mechanism study informed by all previous results. No cohort is a newly untouched confirmation set. Preserve every previous result and generate no report.

input_decomposition.notation: l,c,r denote the previous, centre and next 3-mm common-grid slices after the existing intensity augmentation
input_decomposition.clipping: No additional clipping: preserve the exact component intervention. Quantify out-of-[0,1] values as a representation limitation.
input_decomposition.interpretation: Retrained input-component ablations, not proof of a physiological mechanism. Input distribution, boundary padding and optimization may mediate effects. All arms retain the identical central slice and network capacity.

training: Identical fitting/development patients, initialization, patch schedule, mild intensity augmentation, optimizer and 40k cosine schedule to previous continuation. Degradation augmentation remains factors 1/2/3 with probabilities .5/.25/.25. Select best f1 development model-grid patient Dice, earliest tie.
contrasts: augmentation differences of all five contrasts
statistics: Native-grid patient macro Dice and HD95. Separate cohorts. Average the three seed-specific scores within each patient, then 10000 paired-patient bootstrap replicates; show crossed patient/seed bootstrap and every seed. All intervals exploratory, no multiplicity-adjusted confirmation or test-based checkpoint selection.

case_study.source: Previous fresh20 40k f3 context-by-augmentation patient interaction; freeze selection before looking at images
case_study.patients: Two largest positive effects, two most negative effects, and two closest-to-zero effects; unique cases, ties by case ID
case_study.organ: Largest absolute organ-level interaction averaged across seeds, ties by existing organ order
case_study.slices: One axial slice with largest reference-organ area and one axial slice with largest total FP+FN across the four original planar arms; retain both unless identical
case_study.quantification: For all 60 prior evaluated patients, four original planar arms, three seeds, f1/f3: organ Dice, FP/FN volumes, recall/precision, confusion counts and superior/inferior versus middle organ extent errors. Save every case, not only selected examples.
case_study.interpretation: Post hoc illustrative cases, not representative frequency estimates. All-patient summaries provide the frequency context.
